summary: Decompose ChangeBrief into five independent property-level Gherkin Scenarios covering authorized soft-hold reserve, insufficient-stock failure, unauthorized failure, authorized release, and TTL expiry restore, with checkable OpenAPI and UML OCL surfaces required by acceptance_of_whole.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Reservation service covers soft-hold lifecycle and named failures
  Given the inventory reservation service for clients
  When clients exercise authorized reserve, insufficient-stock reserve, unauthorized reserve or release, authorized release, and TTL expiry
  Then authorized reserve creates a TTL hold and reduces available stock by the reserved quantity
  And insufficient stock and unauthorized callers fail with named domain errors without creating a hold or mutating stock
  And authorized release and TTL expiry restore held quantity to available stock
  And openapi/openapi.yaml, contracts/**/*.ocl, and tests/contracts/** make these behaviors checkable
  And payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, backorders, durable shared persistence, and formal concurrency specs are not required

human_gate.reason: ChangeBrief scope is explicit with empty open_questions; five property-level Scenarios map cleanly to in_scope and success_criteria without blocking ambiguity.

items.intent: Allow an authorized opaque principal to soft-hold SKU quantity for a TTL, creating a hold and reducing available stock via a checkable service surface.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Authorized reserve creates a soft-hold and reduces available stock
  Given a reservation service with a SKU whose available stock is at least the requested quantity
  And an authorized opaque principal
  When the principal requests a soft-hold reservation of a quantity against that SKU
  Then a hold is created for a TTL
  And available stock decreases by the reserved quantity
items.scenario_name: Authorized reserve creates a soft-hold and reduces available stock

items.intent: Fail reserve when available stock is below the requested quantity with a named domain error, creating no hold and leaving stock unchanged.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Reserve fails when available stock is below the requested quantity
  Given a reservation service with a SKU whose available stock is below the requested quantity
  And an authorized opaque principal
  When the principal requests a soft-hold reservation of that quantity against the SKU
  Then the operation fails with a named domain error
  And no hold is created
  And available stock is unchanged
items.scenario_name: Reserve fails when available stock is below the requested quantity

items.intent: Fail reserve or release when the caller is unauthorized with a named domain error, never mutating stock or holds.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Unauthorized reserve or release fails with a named domain error
  Given a reservation service with stock and holds
  And an unauthorized caller
  When the caller attempts to reserve or release
  Then the operation fails with a named domain error
  And no hold is created by the failed attempt
  And available stock and existing holds are unchanged
items.scenario_name: Unauthorized reserve or release fails with a named domain error

items.intent: Allow an authorized opaque principal to release a hold so the held quantity returns to available stock.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Authorized release restores held quantity to available stock
  Given an existing soft-hold created by an authorized opaque principal
  When that principal releases the hold
  Then the held quantity is restored to available stock
items.scenario_name: Authorized release restores held quantity to available stock

items.intent: Treat holds past TTL as expired and restore the held quantity to available stock.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Hold past TTL expires and restores available stock
  Given an existing soft-hold whose TTL has elapsed
  When the reservation service treats the hold as expired
  Then the held quantity is restored to available stock
items.scenario_name: Hold past TTL expires and restores available stock
